modality.note: Multimodal samples have a non-null image_path pointing to a PNG in data/images/. All 1,870 multimodal samples are malicious. Text-only samples have image_path=null.

images.historical_note: Module C originally generated 3,687 image artifacts during pipeline execution. 1,870 were retained and are included in this release. The remaining 1,817 are not part of the downloadable release.
images.source: All images in data/images/ are Module C synthetic outputs. They are project-generated composite document images. Underlying document backgrounds may incorporate third-party source material; see docs/LICENSE_NOTES.md.

five_module_pipeline.Module_A: Analysis, Configuration, Payload Bank — defines 15 attack families and 58 payloads
five_module_pipeline.Module_B: One-to-one text injection — generates 144,937 injected malicious text records
five_module_pipeline.Module_C: Multimodal artifact generation — images, PDFs, labels (3,687 images produced; 1,870 retained)
five_module_pipeline.Module_D: Dataset validation + grouped splits + Parquet builder (Image + Text modalities)
five_module_pipeline.Module_E: Benchmark Dataset Builder — merges benign + malicious, applies group-aware splits, outputs final benchmark

reproducibility.split_group_key: sample_id numeric suffix (pairs benign_NNNNNNNN with malicious_NNNNNNNN)
reproducibility.determinism_note: Pipeline is reproducible under the documented configuration and random seed, with potential environment-dependent variation in OCR and image rendering.
